architecture.allocation: one direct network emits legal SOXL/SOXX/cash weights
architecture.path_risk_control: the selected candidate may causally scale the model's full risky allocation from prior realized equity and running peak; cash remains the residual model state
architecture.tail_encoder: shared SOXX-style encoder; constituent synthetic-2x labels enter training loss only
architecture.inference_inputs: original SOXL/SOXX features plus SOXX OHLCV common features; no constituent or 2x input at inference

auxiliary.actual_2x_role: calibrates synthetic daily-reset labels; short histories are not pooled into allocation rows
auxiliary.pre_pit_limitation: union backfill is survivorship-biased and receives 0.25 training weight; it is a separately selectable pretrain source
